user.title: AERO C14 – Unofficial Home Assistant Integration
user.description: Local Serial or TCP/RS485 connection. Polling without iNext is optional and disabled by default.

serial.title: Serial
serial.description: Receive-only by default. Enable local mode after disconnecting iNext; it enables polling and bypass and boost control through HA entities. Enabling it alone does not change settings. Nano remains master. Serial: 9600/8N1. TCP: transparent gateway; physical TCP has not been tested.

data_description.disable_gateway_detection: Detection is enabled by default. Select only to work around false detections. When disabled, you are responsible for keeping iNext and other C14 gateways disconnected from this bus while Home Assistant polls locally.

start_capture.name: Start raw RX capture
start_capture.description: Use the existing receiver, at most 15 minutes and 10 MiB. Limit of 5 files; older files are never deleted automatically.

entry_id.description: Optional when only one device is loaded.

stop_capture.name: Stop raw RX capture
stop_capture.description: Finish the file while normal reception continues.

get_schedule.name: Read Nano schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns all eight days, including Holiday, from received parameter data.

refresh_day.name: Refresh day from device
refresh_day.description: Optional priority read without changing settings; requires extended local mode.

set_schedule_period.name: Set Nano schedule period
set_schedule_period.description: Writes one period using separately confirmed boundaries. Not atomic; a failure may leave a partial change. Requires extended local mode.

refresh_parameters.name: Refresh parameters
refresh_parameters.description: Priority reads of allowlisted keys, without setting writes. Keys sharing one batch are read once.

user_control.name: User control
user_control.description: Choose a mode, gear or boost preset. Each write must be confirmed; failure stops the sequence.

capture_unavailable.message: The receiver is stopped or a capture is already running.

capture_io_error.message: Could not open or finish the capture file. Check diagnostics.

capture_quota_reached.message: Capture storage quota reached. Export and remove older captures.

control_unavailable.message: Control requires active local mode and fresh device data.

command_not_confirmed.message: The device did not confirm the change. Check its current state before trying again.

manual_gear_unknown.message: The gear for entering manual mode is unknown. Select a manual gear on Nano.

invalid_schedule.message: Use same-day quarter-hour intervals; end may be 24:00. 00:00/00:00 disables a period.

schedule_not_confirmed.message: Schedule update was not fully confirmed. Some boundaries may have changed; read the current schedule before retrying.

invalid_parameter_value.message: Use an allowed option or a value matching the setting range and step.
